name: avc_bench
description: AVC Bench (Audio-Visual Correspondence benchmark) evaluates models on whether visual and audio streams correspond, typically used for self-supervised audio-visual representation learning and cross-modal matching. It contains paired audio and video/image samples and measures a model's ability to verify correspondence or detect mismatches. The benchmark is used to assess alignment and fusion quality of audio-visual models.
reputation: A niche research benchmark used in audio-visual/self-supervised learning literature with modest community adoption.
